sections.title: College Athletics and Higher Education: Money, Power, Politics
sections.description: Higher Education campus leaders should understand the roles and issues facing college sports in the 21st century. This course provided a holistic view of the impact of athletics has on enrollment and retention, institutional finances, diversity and inclusion, and the legal and risk management challenges it brings to your campus organization. The course will also examine the powerful external influences on athletics, including trustees, donors and sports media.
